{{Top|leg}}
The '''Polestar Reception Room''' was a receiving area located adjacent to the [[Grand Hall]] of the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate Rotunda]]. Diplomatic guests that had just arrived would be received here, and taken to where they needed to be afterwards.
